This is a wiki converted from a Keep project. Feel free to replace the text here with your own to explain the purpose of the wiki. 

Here is some useful information about the wiki and tips for getting started. This page has important 

It has [[Special:AllPages|{{NUMBEROFARTICLES}} articles]] and counting. It has {{NUMBEROFFILES}} Images across its pages.

If you want to look at the pages that went the longest without being edited, you can view them [[Special:AncientPages|here]] which is useful for updating outdated pages

You can view the main categories here [[:Category:Top level categories]], all imported pages will be present here

Here are some other useful page lists or you can explore all of them here [[Special:SpecialPages]]

==Other Special Pages==
* [[Special:WantedPages]] This page tracks all pages with links to them that do not exist. It will not have any results immediately after importing from Keep, but it can be very useful later on. The more links to a page that does not exist the higher it will be on this list, so linking a page that does not exist can be a useful editing strategy to track what you need to write next.
* [[Special:ShortPages]] this page lists the shortest pages on the wiki. This can be useful for seeing pages that had the least work put into them, especially immediately after importing. But some pages do not need to be very long. If you want another tool see the next entry
* [[Special:FewestRevisions]] Useful for finding neglected pages you didn't do much work on, but if the wiki was converted recently, all pages will have two revisions, due to technical limitations with keep.
* [[Special:WantedCategories]] This page shows all categories that do not exist but have member pages. After importing this page will not have any entries, but it is useful once you have been using your wiki for a long period
* [[Special:UnusedCategories]] this page lists all categories that have no members. It might be a good idea to delete these categories to help keep the wiki uncluttered.
* [[Special:UncategorizedCategories]] this category covers all categories that are not in other categories. Ideally this category [[:Category:Top level categories]] should be the only one present. This means you can find every other category and article from that category.
* [[Special:AncientPages]] as mentioned earlier in the intro. This page shows all pages by their most recent edit. Due to technical issues with importing they will likely all be tied, but if this wiki is properly imported then the wiki will show them from the last time they were edited on keep.
* [[Special:UnusedFiles]] this page lists all images that are not used on an existing page. This will likely be zero at first, but if you remove outdated images from pages, or delete pages this one will fill up.
* [[Special:WantedFiles]] this page lists all images that are linked but not uploaded. This normally indicates an error in importing if there are many listed files immediately after import. But if you have been using this wiki for a long time it might instead contain files that you deleted but forgot to remove from pages, or files you linked but forgot to upload
